mentions.description: A system (in development, no repo yet) that connects texts such as books and research papers in a meaningful way, to help people decide what to read and be aware of how texts relate to each other. The builder plans to make it open-source later.
mentions.problem: People struggle to decide what to read and to see how different texts relate to each other.
mentions.audience: People deciding what to read (e.g., readers and researchers of books and research papers)
mentions.author: nwhnwh

supporting.summary: Builder confirms there is no repo yet but plans to release the project as open-source later.
supporting.excerpt: Not yet, but I am planning on making it open-source later.
supporting.author: nwhnwh
